spans.text: 5 — Nothing that crosses the boundary carries authority.

Editing a returned issue response's binding (committed and value) throws, changes neither the grant record nor the history, and leaves a refused revalidation refused. Editing a supplied profile after construction or reconfiguration moves nothing. Editing a history read, a state snapshot, a grant read, a retained envelope, or the registry's entry array changes nothing held. The slice-3 model failed all of these.
